summary: Backend engineer with 6 years building Python data pipelines and REST APIs on PostgreSQL, orchestrated with Apache Airflow and deployed via Docker/Kubernetes.

bullets.text: Designed and shipped Python REST APIs consumed by 40+ internal services.
Optimized PostgreSQL schemas and queries, cutting p95 latency 35% across core tables.
Built Apache Airflow DAGs orchestrating nightly ETL across 12 data sources.
Containerized every pipeline service with Docker and wrote the Kubernetes manifests used for staging rollout.

chunks.text: Designed and shipped Python REST APIs consumed by 40+ internal services at Nimbus Analytics Inc, using FastAPI and typed request/response contracts.
Optimized PostgreSQL schemas and queries, cutting p95 latency 35% across core tables handling 2M+ rows at Nimbus Analytics Inc.
Built Apache Airflow DAGs orchestrating nightly ETL across 12 data sources at Beacon Data Co, with SLA alerting on failed tasks.
Containerized every pipeline service with Docker and wrote the Kubernetes manifests used for the staging rollout at Beacon Data Co.
BSc Computer Science, Fraser Valley Institute of Technology, graduated 2018.
